items.name: New long-term premium nuclear contracts
items.claim: Constellation Energy secured ~920 MWs of New Long-Term Premium Nuclear Contracts, with an average contract duration of 18.5 years.
items.source_excerpt: Secured ~920 MWs of New Long-Term Premium Nuclear Contracts (1) ~30% of Expected Baseload Clean Generation MWhs under Long-Term Agreement by 2032 (1) 6 Average contract duration of 18.5 years

items.name: Meta 20-year PPA for Clinton Clean Energy Center
items.claim: Constellation and Meta signed a 20-year power purchase agreement for the output of the Clinton Clean Energy Center, supporting Meta's clean energy goals with 1,121 megawatts of emissions-free nuclear energy.
items.source_excerpt: Constellation (Nasdaq: CEG) and Meta have signed a 20-year power purchase agreement (PPA) for the output of the Clinton Clean Energy Center to support Meta’s clean energy goals and operations in the region with 1,121 megawatts of emissions-free nuclear energy.

items.name: Microsoft 20-year PPA for Crane Clean Energy Center (TMI Unit 1 restart)
items.claim: Constellation signed a 20-year power purchase agreement with Microsoft that will pave the way for the launch of the Crane Clean Energy Center, adding approximately 835 megawatts of carbon-free energy to the grid.
items.source_excerpt: add approximately 835 megawatts of carbon-free energy to the grid; create 3,400 direct and indirect jobs and deliver more than $3 billion in state and federal taxes LONDONDERRY, PA (Sept 20, 2024) Constellation (Nasdaq: CEG) announced today the signing of a 20-year power purchase agreement with Microsoft

notes: Constellation discloses ~920 MWs of new long-term premium nuclear contracts in its Q2 2026 investor presentation, plus two named large data-center-linked nuclear PPAs: Meta/Clinton (1,121 MW, 2025-06-03) and Microsoft/Crane-TMI Unit 1 (835 MW, 2024-09-20), both fetched as web_doc (REQ-20260914-792, REQ-20260914-793, pull-data skill).
